reason: Tata Chemicals North America has acquired customer contracts expected to generate over USD 110 million in revenue through 2028, indicating a direct increase in future sales.
why_now: The company announced this acquisition via a press release on August 29, 2026, making it a fresh catalyst.
source_headlines: Tata Chemicals Limited: Tata Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 29, 2026, titled "Tata Chemicals North America acquires customer contracts expected to generate over USD 110 million in revenue through 2028".
